content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Senior Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine) and 1 for Perfusionist.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine): M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology or equivalent recognized by AERB, Mumbai with 01 year experience of working in the Nuclear Medicine Department of a hospital. Candidates having the certification of Radiological Safety Officer Level-II will be preferred. Perfusionist: B.Sc. Degree of a recognized University with Certificate in Perfusion Technology (awarded by a recognized institution/Association/Authority such as Association of Thoracic and Cardio Vascular Surgeons of India) after a training in a Centre with at least one year experience in Clinical Perfusion. Desirable: Working experience in clinical perfusion.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Mangalagiri to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Various Non-Faculty Posts is 19th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Non-Faculty posts at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Various Non-Faculty Posts at AIIMS Mangalagiri. These vacancies are for the positions of Senior Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine) and Perfusionist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Perfusionist post?
faq.answer: For the Perfusionist post, candidates need a B.Sc. Degree from a recognized University with a Certificate in Perfusion Technology and at least one year of experience in Clinical Perfusion. Working experience in clinical perfusion is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 1000. Candidates must ensure they pay the fee as per the instructions mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Medical Physicist post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine) post is Rs. 108320 per month. This is a contractual position, and the salary is as per the institute's norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual posts at AIIMS Mangalagiri will primarily involve an Interview/Evaluation followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to prepare thoroughly for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories. SC/ST candidates get 5 years of relaxation, OBC-NCL candidates get 3 years, and PWBD candidates get 10 years of relaxation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 is online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.
